9.      Section  18  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended in subsection (2), by the repeal of paragraph (a)
thereof,  and  the  substitution  therefor  of  the  following
shall  carry  out  such  activities  either  in  a  Free
Port or a Bonded Area declared by regulations
under this Act ;” .
The  following  sections  are    hereby  inserted
immediately after section 18 of the principal enactment and
shall have effect as sections 18A, 18B  and 18C thereof:-
18A.  (1)  Subject  to  the  provisions  of
subsections (2) and (3), there shall be exempted,
from  the  application  of  the  provisions  of  the
Acts referred to in the Schedule  hereto,  any
enterprise engaged in any one or more of the
following  businesses,  within  the  meaning  of
an  agreement  entered  into  with  the  Board  of
Investment of Sri Lanka, under the Board of
Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978-

(a)
entrepot trade involving import, minor
processing and re- export;

(b)
off-shore business where goods can be

procured

country
